generated.description: A large floating airship with a sword-like hull, built mostly from iron blocks, oak planks and white wool, with lapis and gold accents and glowing lights. It is about 153 blocks wide, 71 high and 75 deep, and contains a few rooms with chests, bookshelves, an enchanting table, a furnace, a record player and signs. The source gives no description, so the sword-like shape is inferred from the top-down and side silhouettes.
